description: This file declares the PersistentStoreImplementation class, which implements multiple interfaces related to a persistent storage system, including notification handling, cache management, and storage limits. It also defines an internal notification class for handling store updates.

classes.name: PersistentStoreImplementation
classes.description: Implements storage, notification, cache, and limit interfaces for persistent storage management within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Internal class for handling notifications from the store, forwarding value changes to registered clients.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client to receive store updates.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification client from receiving store updates.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the store within the DEVICE scope.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given key within the DEVICE scope.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key within the DEVICE scope.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace within the DEVICE scope.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.
